component.name: Document Searcher
component.summary: Search through documents in a folder

description.p: Document Searcher recursively searches supported documents in a selected folder.
It provides Unicode-aware full-text search, context previews, native text extraction, and OCR for image files and scanned PDFs when the OCR runtime is installed.
Supported formats: TXT, Markdown, Rust, TOML, JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, PDF, DOCX, PNG, JPEG, TIFF, and BMP.
